modules.inputContract: At least two positive failure-time observations at distinct finite temperatures.
modules.outputContract: Finite activation-energy regression diagnostics and lifetime projection helper.
modules.scientificBoundary: Extrapolation under an Arrhenius assumption; not a measured service-life guarantee.

modules.inputContract: At least three complete finite historical records with one or more design variables and a finite target.
modules.outputContract: Seed-reproducible RBF Gaussian-process candidates ranked by expected improvement.
modules.scientificBoundary: Surrogate-guided candidate ranking, not experimental confirmation.

modules.inputContract: At least five positive finite shear-rate and viscosity observations.
modules.outputContract: Bounded four-parameter Carreau-Yasuda fit with residual and Jacobian diagnostics.
modules.scientificBoundary: Model fit within the observed rheology domain; not an unqualified extrapolation.

modules.inputContract: Complete finite paired observations with enough non-constant rank variation.
modules.outputContract: Normal-score correlation and finite Gaussian-copula density grid.
modules.scientificBoundary: Dependence model, not causal attribution.

modules.inputContract: A product collection with structured property values and optional finite thresholds.
modules.outputContract: Completeness, z-score/IQR outlier summaries and explicit empty-state output.
modules.mathematicalContract: z=(x-mean)/sd and IQR fences [Q1-k IQR, Q3+k IQR]
modules.scientificBoundary: Screening flags requiring source-data review.

modules.inputContract: Serializable rows, sorting, filtering and pagination instructions.
modules.outputContract: Deterministic filtered/sorted row slices and counts.
modules.scientificBoundary: Data presentation utility; no scientific inference.

modules.inputContract: Complete finite rows exceeding the number of standardized predictors plus intercept.
modules.outputContract: Normalized absolute ridge coefficients with least-squares diagnostics.
modules.scientificBoundary: Associative ridge coefficients, not causality or SHAP.

modules.inputContract: Finite property history and an explicit deterministic scenario algorithm.
modules.outputContract: Finite scenario path and stated heuristic band.
modules.scientificBoundary: Scenario projection, not a validated statistical forecast interval.

modules.inputContract: Serializable product history and diff requests.
modules.outputContract: Deterministic history/diff payloads.
modules.scientificBoundary: Audit utility; does not infer scientific meaning.

modules.inputContract: At least two finite two-dimensional observations and bounded grid size.
modules.outputContract: Finite direct product-Gaussian density grid.
modules.scientificBoundary: Smoothed density estimate; not a causal surface.

modules.inputContract: At least three finite positive heating rates and absolute peak temperatures.
modules.outputContract: Finite Kissinger regression, activation energy and diagnostics.
modules.scientificBoundary: Estimate under the selected kinetic model.

modules.inputContract: Finite row-major matrices and bounded benchmark profiles.
modules.outputContract: Reproducible backend timing, equivalence and environment evidence.
modules.scientificBoundary: Device-specific performance evidence, not a universal speed guarantee.

modules.inputContract: Finite observations, feature keys, K bounds and an optional validated backend profile.
modules.outputContract: Clusters plus backend-decision evidence.
modules.scientificBoundary: Exploratory unsupervised grouping.

modules.inputContract: Complete finite feature vectors and valid K range.
modules.outputContract: Finite centroids, assignments and diagnostic metrics.
modules.scientificBoundary: Exploratory grouping dependent on selected features and scaling.

modules.inputContract: Complete finite observations with sample count greater than feature count.
modules.outputContract: Regularized covariance, finite distances and chi-square threshold diagnostics.
modules.scientificBoundary: Multivariate anomaly screening, not proof of invalidity.

modules.inputContract: A valid formula graph, one product, non-negative finite variances, bounded iteration count and optional seed.
modules.outputContract: Seed-reproducible finite samples, empirical quantiles and exact direct Gaussian KDE.
modules.mathematicalContract: Empirical simulation under configured normal perturbations
modules.scientificBoundary: Simulation distribution under assumptions, not parameter confidence intervals.

modules.inputContract: At least three complete finite records, one or more design variables and at least two targets.
modules.outputContract: Seed-reproducible surrogate candidates and Pareto frontier.
modules.scientificBoundary: Surrogate optimization candidates require experimental review.

modules.inputContract: Finite objective values and at least one explicit minimize/maximize direction.
modules.outputContract: Stable identifiers for non-dominated observations.
modules.mathematicalContract: No other point is at least as good in all objectives and strictly better in one
modules.scientificBoundary: Trade-off screening depends on selected objectives.

modules.inputContract: Positive finite frequency-domain storage/loss observations and bounded term count.
modules.outputContract: Non-negative regularized Prony coefficients, relaxation times and residual diagnostics.
modules.scientificBoundary: Reduced constitutive representation within the supplied domain.

modules.inputContract: Enough complete finite observations for the selected quadratic response-surface terms.
modules.outputContract: Finite polynomial coefficients, fit diagnostics and response grid.
modules.scientificBoundary: Local empirical response surface.

modules.inputContract: At least two unique products and two named features; strict finite numeric parsing, explicit threshold and optional edge bounds.
modules.outputContract: Observed-only z-score cosine edges adjusted by shared active-feature coverage, with overlap and allocation diagnostics.
modules.mathematicalContract: s_adj(x,y)=clamp(cos(z_x,z_y),-1,1) * |F_x∩F_y|/|F_active|, requiring at least two shared active features.
modules.scientificBoundary: Feature-space similarity with explicit missingness penalty, not chemical equivalence.

modules.inputContract: Valid formula graph, finite non-negative variance settings, bounded iteration count and optional seed.
modules.outputContract: Seed-reproducible first-order sensitivity estimates and diagnostics.
modules.scientificBoundary: Current sampler is reproducible pseudorandom sampling, not a low-discrepancy Sobol sequence.

modules.inputContract: At least two finite values and valid specification limits with USL greater than LSL.
modules.outputContract: Finite center, spread, control limits and process-capability metrics.
modules.scientificBoundary: Descriptive SPC under the supplied sampling assumptions.

modules.inputContract: At least two listwise-complete finite observations and two unique feature keys.
modules.outputContract: Finite symmetric average-rank correlation matrix with constant-feature diagnostics.
modules.scientificBoundary: Monotonic association, not causality.

modules.inputContract: At least three positive finite observations.
modules.outputContract: Finite Bernard-rank two-parameter linearized Weibull fit.
modules.scientificBoundary: Bernard-rank linearized estimator, not maximum-likelihood estimation.

modules.inputContract: At least two positive finite rheology curves at distinct temperatures.
modules.outputContract: Finite horizontal shift factors and alignment diagnostics.
modules.scientificBoundary: Horizontal time-temperature shift model; vertical shift is not fitted.
